title: Modulation Mechanisms of Transmembrane Domain Flexibility in Amyloid Precursor Protein and Notch: A Coarse-Grained Simulation Study on the Impact of Upper and Lower Leaflet Composition in Liquid-Ordered and Liquid-Disordered Ternary Bilayer Membranes.
authors: Ahmad, Sajjad; Mei, Jinfei; Wang, Chuanbo; Jia, Mengke; Nouman, Muhammad Fahad; Ai, Hongqi
journal: Langmuir : the ACS journal of surfaces and colloids
one_liner_zh: 该研究用粗粒化模拟探讨膜脂组成对APP和Notch跨膜域柔性的调控，虽涉及跨膜蛋白与膜环境互作，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) and Notch-related pathologies are linked to dysregulated gamma-secretase cleavage of amyloid precursor protein (APP) and Notch transmembrane domains (TMDs). However, gamma-secretase inhibitors for AD often disrupt Notch signaling, necessitating strategies to selectively modulate substrate cleavage. This study employs coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations to investigate how lipid bilayer composition horizontal line specifically liquid-ordered (Lo) and liquid-disordered (Ld) phases with varying cholesterol (Chol), palmitoyl-sphingomyelin, and 1,2-dioleoyl-sn-phosphatidylcholine ratios horizontal line impacts the flexibility and stability of APP and Notch TMDs. Our key findings reveal that Chol-rich Lo phases enhance APP TMD flexibility, promoting gamma-secretase cleavage and Abeta production, while Notch TMD stability is largely unaffected by Chol, favoring Ld phases, replicating perfectly the existing experimental observations and resolving several conflicting perspectives. A critical innovation lies in identifying asymmetric lipid compositions (e.g., Chol-enriched lower leaflets) as regulators of APP-Notch selectivity. These results highlight membrane microenvironment engineering as a promising therapeutic avenue to decouple APP and Notch processing. Future work should validate these findings experimentally and explore lipid-based modulators for AD treatment with reduced side effects.
abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）和Notch相关病理与淀粉样前体蛋白（amyloid precursor protein, APP）及Notch跨膜结构域（transmembrane domains, TMDs）的γ-分泌酶切割失调有关。然而，用于AD的γ-分泌酶抑制剂常会干扰Notch信号传导，因此需要选择性调节底物切割的策略。本研究采用粗粒化分子动力学（coarse-grained molecular dynamics）模拟，探讨脂质双层膜组成——具体为具有不同胆固醇（cholesterol, Chol）、棕榈酰鞘磷脂和1,2-二油酰-sn-磷脂酰胆碱比例的液态有序（liquid-ordered, Lo）和液态无序（liquid-disordered, Ld）相——如何影响APP和Notch TMDs的柔性与稳定性。我们的关键发现表明，富含Chol的Lo相增强APP TMD的柔性，促进γ-分泌酶切割和Aβ产生，而Notch TMD的稳定性基本不受Chol影响，偏好Ld相，这完美复现了现有实验观察结果，并解决了若干相互矛盾的观点。一个关键创新在于识别不对称脂质组成（例如，富含Chol的下层叶）作为APP-Notch选择性的调节因子。这些结果强调膜微环境工程是解耦APP和Notch加工的一个有前景的治疗途径。未来工作应在实验上验证这些发现，并探索基于脂质的调节剂用于AD治疗，以减少副作用。
